⚡ Ministers are promoting a VAT cut on household electricity worth around 45 pounds a year from October.

The current price cap is 1,663 pounds. E.ON Next forecasts 1,717 for October and Cornwall Insight's range runs to 1,747. Ofgem publishes the real figure by 26 August.

The giveaway may be gone before the first bill lands.
